nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=34 beats='Miri stands in the courtyard. Tiny Pip is missing from the coop! The morning breeze is chilly, and the schoolyard feels huge.'>>
<<FILL role=setup words=34 beats='Miri looks around the empty school. She could check the play area, head over to the vegetable garden, or walk toward the brick classrooms.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri runs to the playground. The red swings sway in the wind, and the wooden sandbox is filled with yellow shovels. Pip might be hiding here.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri approaches the tall metal swings. The heavy seats hang low to the ground. She wonders if the little brown hen is underneath.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri checks under the swings but only finds a brown leaf. Pip is not here. The warning bell rings, and Miri must go inside.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri steps into the wooden sandbox. She sees a large green plastic bucket flipped upside down near the edge. A tiny bird could fit under there.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri flips the bucket. No hen! But she spots tiny scratches in the dirt that look like chicken tracks leading toward the garden.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri digs in the sand where the bucket was and finds a lost toy truck. But no Pip. The bell rings, ending her search.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri enters the damp school garden. Tall cornstalks rustle loudly. She can search the red tool shed or look near the empty clay pots.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The wooden tool shed is locked tight, but there is a wide gap underneath. Miri kneels down to see if any small feathers are poking out.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri peers under the shed door and spots a lost green tennis ball, but no chicken. A teacher calls out, meaning the search must pause.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='A stack of empty clay pots sits near the wire fence. The largest pot has a jagged hole in its side. A frightened bird might squeeze inside.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri peeks into the dark pot. It is empty! But she discovers a single brown feather resting on the rim, blowing toward the brick classrooms.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri walks along the red brick wall of the classrooms. She sees the outdoor student cubbies and a neat stack of welcome mats near the door.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The wooden outdoor cubbies are filled with muddy rain boots. Miri thinks she hears a faint rustling sound coming from the deep shadow at the back.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri reaches into the cubby and knocks over a heavy rubber boot. The loud thump makes her jump. She realizes Pip is nowhere near the boots.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='A soft blue reading bench sits under the window. Miri notices a small, dark space underneath the wooden seat where an animal could easily hide.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri crouches down to look under the blue bench, but she only finds an old crumpled spelling test. Miri frowns, wishing she knew where Pip went.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='There is a neat stack of bristly welcome mats. Sometimes the chickens like to scratch at the rough fibers. Miri looks closely for tiny muddy footprints.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri lifts the heavy rubber mat. She finds a few scattered yellow seeds, exactly like chicken feed! Pip must have gone toward the coop.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri is finally back near the wire fence of the coop. Big Dot and noisy Mac are safely inside. Pip could be hiding nearby.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The metal feed bin is tall and shiny. The heavy lid is slightly crooked this morning. Maybe the tiny hen fluttered up for a giant breakfast.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri pushes the metal lid open. The bin is full of grain, but there is no hen inside. The morning bell begins to chime loudly.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The wooden nesting boxes jut out from the side of the main coop. Miri gently lifts the flap to check the cozy, straw-filled squares.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri carefully feels the dry straw but finds absolutely nothing. Pip is still lost, and Miri feels defeated without her little feathered friend.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri walks around to the back of the wire enclosure. The grass is much taller here. She sees a thick row of green bushes and a wooden ramp.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The leafy bushes are very dense. Miri crouches low to the ground and listens carefully. She hears a soft clucking noise coming from the shadows.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri gently parts the green leaves. There is Pip, safely nestled in a hollow scoop of dirt! Miri happily carries her home to her sisters.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The wooden ramp creates a tiny, dark triangle against the chainlink fence. It blocks the chilly wind perfectly. Miri kneels to peer into the shadows.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri crawls under the wooden ramp and finds Pip fast asleep on a pile of dry oak leaves. She carefully picks up the tiny hen, smiling brightly.'>>
